recipes.oracle_text:
Target creature gains deathtouch until end of turn and must be blocked this turn if able.
Flashback {G} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

recipe_coverage: Reviewed temporary ability component through normal casting/response/stack and real combat: declared signed-free stat bonuses, targeting, flying/reach legality, trample allocation, first/double strike, lifelink, deathtouch, indestructibility versus destruction/damage/zero toughness, hexproof/shroud ownership, and freshly cast haste/ability removal where declared. Includes cleanup/expiry, populated owned zones, exact cost, snapshot/AI replay, untapping/draw/life/death-loss components as declared. Additional Oracle clauses (must-block requirements, ferocious trample, alternate costs, overload, flashback, kicker effects, madness, split-second response prohibition) require separate authored cases. Not whole-card certification. The mandatory-block component also uses the legal blocker-choice trigger before combat damage.
